skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Sent from Ognisko
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Sent from Ognisko. Clothes Viviana wore on a short return trip to Ognisko, a pure linen dress paired with a knitted shawl. With these, she wanders the city of shady trees and the sounds of artisans.
skins.quote: The weather vane points to today's destination. Her felt friends escort her there, while every nameless roadside flower blooms among her idle thoughts. She may soon leave again, but her time here will be forever preserved in poetry.
